DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の道についてのご案内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions around the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。祖父の車いすを押して、春の花壇を見に行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者の車いすと見たい場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to push my grandfather's wheelchair to see the spring flowerbeds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your companion's wheelchair and where you want to go. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 花壇へは左手の舗装された道をお進みください。右の近道は砂利道です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Take the paved path on the left to the flowerbeds. The shortcut on the right is gravel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 舗装された道の途中に、段差はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 経路の段差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Are there any steps along the paved path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about changes in level on the route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇までは段差のない道です。小さな橋の手前で右に曲がってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The route to the flowerbeds has no steps. Turn right before the small bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 花壇の近くに、祖父の車いすの横で私も座れるベンチはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車いすの隣で座れる場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is there a bench near the flowerbeds where I can sit beside my grandfather's wheelchair?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to sit beside the wheelchair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、ベンチの横に広いスペースがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, there is a spacious area beside the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは北の出口から出たいのですが、この道につながっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の出口へ続く道を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to leave through the north exit afterwards. Does this path connect to it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the route to another exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 花壇の先の舗装路が北の出口まで続いています。出口を出ると駐車場です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The paved path beyond the flowerbeds continues to the north exit. Outside is the parking lot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、舗装路で花壇へ行って、ベンチで休んでから北の駐車場へ出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花壇と休憩と帰路の順をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then we will take the paved path to the flowerbeds, rest at the bench, and leave for the north parking lot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the flowerbeds, rest, and route home in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、花を楽しんできてください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, enjoy the flowers. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符の変更でしょうか。お持ちの切符を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you changing your ticket? Let me see it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰りの予定が延びたので、この四時の列車を五時に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰りの列車を遅い時刻に変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My plans for returning have been delayed. I want to change this four o'clock train to five.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a later return train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ区間で五時発ですね。お一人分の変更でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Five o'clock on the same section, correct? Is the change for one person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、一人です。今の切符は窓側ですが、変更後も窓側にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数を答え窓側の席を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, one. My current seat is a window seat. Could the new one also be by the window?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the passenger count and request a window seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 五時の列車は通路側だけ空いています。お席を移してもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Only aisle seats are available on the five o'clock train. May we move your seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通路側で大丈夫です。追加料金はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路側を了承し追加料金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: An aisle seat is fine. How much extra does it cost?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to an aisle seat and ask the additional charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回は追加料金はありません。元の切符を回収して、新しい切符をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is no additional charge this time. We will collect the old ticket and give you a new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。前の切符は、もう使わないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更を依頼し元の切符の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. The previous ticket will no longer be used, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the change and confirm handling of the old ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらが新しい切符です。五時発、三号車の十二番をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Here is the new ticket. Please check: five o'clock departure, car three, seat twelve.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五時、三号車の十二番ですね。かばんの切符入れに入れておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更後の時刻と座席を確認し保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Five o'clock, car three, seat twelve. I will put it in the ticket holder in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the changed time and seat and store the ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変更は以上です。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That completes the change. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その用紙は市の生活調査ですね。回答をお持ちいただいたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: That is the city's living-conditions survey, correct? Have you brought your answers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、書いたのですが、返信用の封筒をなくしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入済み回答用紙と封筒紛失を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I filled it in, but lost the return envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the completed response form and lost envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで直接お預かりできます。回答用紙だけお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can accept it directly here. Just hand over the response form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 助かります。このまま渡せば、郵送しなくていいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 直接提出なら郵送不要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That helps. If I give it to you like this, I do not need to mail it, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm direct submission means mailing is unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。最後の欄は空いていますが、記入されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The last section is blank. Would you like to fill it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どの欄ですか。裏にも質問があったのを見落としました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見落とした欄の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Which section? I overlooked the questions on the back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where the overlooked section is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの「よく利用する施設」の欄です。回答は任意ですので、無理に書く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: This “facilities you use often” section. Answers are optional; you do not have to force yourself to write anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 図書館をよく使うので、それを書きたいです。ここでペンを借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用施設を答え筆記具を借りる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I often use the library, so I want to write that. May I borrow a pen here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Name the facility you use and borrow a pen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。記入できましたら、この箱へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Put the form in this box when you finish.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図書館と書きました。これで提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加回答を書き提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote “library.” I will submit it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have added an answer and will submit the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。ペンはこちらへお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for helping. Please return the pen here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらで診察までお待ちいただきます。何かご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait here until your examination. Is there anything you would like us to do?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 声の呼び出しが聞こえにくいので、順番に気付けるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 声の呼び出しが聞こえにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have difficulty hearing spoken calls, so I worry I may miss my turn.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say spoken calls are difficult to hear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の画面に受付番号が出ます。番号札はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your reception number appears on the screen in front. Do you have your number slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、三十七番です。あの画面は今の席から見えにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号と画面が見えにくいことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, thirty-seven. That screen is hard to see from my current seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your number and say the screen is difficult to see. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付前の椅子なら、画面が正面に見えます。そちらへ移りましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: From the seats in front of reception, the screen is directly ahead. Shall we move there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。画面に三十七番が出たら、どこへ行けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席の移動を依頼し呼ばれた後の行き先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. When thirty-seven appears, where should I go?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to move seats and where to go after being called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号の横に診察室の番号も出ます。この廊下の案内板で場所をご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The examination-room number also appears beside your number. The signs in this corridor show its location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察室の番号も見るのですね。説明も、顔を見ながらゆっくり話していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面の見方を確認し話し方の配慮を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I should check the room number too. It would also help if you faced me and spoke slowly when explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm how to read the screen and request consideration in speaking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。そのご希望を診察担当にも伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will also tell the examination staff about that request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。受付前の椅子へ移って、番号札を手元に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 移動する席と番号札の置き場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will move to a seat in front of reception and keep my number slip at hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say which seat you will move to and where you will keep the slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞこちらへ。お呼びするまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: This way, please. Wait until we call you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談を伺います。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell us your concern. What is troubling you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の部屋から夜中に大きな音がして、眠れない日が続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜の物音による困り事を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Loud noises from the next room in the middle of the night have kept me from sleeping for several days.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe difficulty caused by nighttime noise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのくらいの時間、どんな音が聞こえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around what time, and what kind of sound do you hear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜の十一時ごろから、床に何かを落とすような音が何度もします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音の時刻と特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: From around eleven at night, there are repeated sounds like things being dropped on the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the time and characteristics of the noise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いつごろから続いていますか。管理会社にはお伝えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Since when has it been happening? Have you told the management company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週からです。管理会社には話しましたが、昨日も聞こえました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 始まった時期と管理会社への相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Since last week. I told management, but heard it again yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say when it started and that you consulted management. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時と聞こえた音を整理しておくと、状況を伝えやすくなります。今、音がしているわけではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Organizing dates, times, and sounds makes it easier to describe. Is there noise occurring right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は静かです。昨夜の時刻をメモしたので、見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の状況を答え記録を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is quiet now. I noted last night's times. Could you look?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the current situation and show your record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拝見します。実際の対応は状況によりますが、ご相談内容を記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me see. The action taken depends on the situation, but we will record your concern.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。次に相談するときも、聞こえた時刻と音を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回の相談で伝える情報を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Next time I consult you, I will again give the times and sounds I heard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm what information you will give in a later consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご心配な状況があれば、またご相談ください。本日はお疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: If anything worries you, consult us again. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切手をお求めですか。お送りになる封筒はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like stamps? Have you brought the envelope you will send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒と同じ物を五通送ります。必要な切手を五枚ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒と必要な切手の枚数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will send five envelopes like this one. Please give me five stamps of the required value.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and state the number of stamps needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの重さなら、一通百十円です。花と山の図柄がありますが、どちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this weight, each costs110 yen. We have flower and mountain designs. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花を三枚、山を二枚にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図柄ごとの枚数を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Could I have three flowers and two mountains?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify quantities for each design. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、合わせて五百五十円です。つながったままお渡ししてよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes,550 yen altogether. May I give them to you still joined together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚ずつ分けてもらえますか。家で封筒に貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切手を一枚ずつ分けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you separate each one? I will put them on the envelopes at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to separate the stamps individually. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。一枚ずつ分けた切手は、そのままお渡ししてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. May I hand over the separated stamps as they are?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手帳に挟んで持ち帰りたいので、小さな袋に入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち帰り方を伝え袋に入れるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to take them home tucked in my planner, so put them in a small bag, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you will carry them and ask for a bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 花が三枚、山が二枚です。どうぞご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Three flowers and two mountains. Please check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五枚そろっています。六百円で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 枚数を確認し支払額を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: All five are here. I will pay with600 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the quantity and state the payment amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 五十円のお返しです。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your change is50 yen. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は硬貨のご入金でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この袋の小銭を、自分の口座へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 硬貨を自分の口座に入金したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want the small change in this bag put into my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to deposit coins into your own account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳と一緒にお預かりします。袋の中に硬貨以外の物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will take them with your passbook. Is there anything other than coins in the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ヘアピンが一つ入っていました。取り出してから渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 硬貨以外の物を除くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a hairpin. I will remove it before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the non-coin item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この一枚は汚れているので、別に確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. This coin is dirty, so let us examine it separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 茶色くなった十円玉ですね。これは使えないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 汚れた硬貨を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The ten-yen coin that has turned brown, right? Is it unusable?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the dirty coin can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状態を確認してからご案内します。ほかの硬貨は機械で数えますが、よろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain after checking its condition. May we count the other coins by machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。枚数が多いと手数料がかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集計を了承し枚数による手数料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. Does having many coins incur a fee?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to counting and ask about fees based on the number of coins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 枚数によりますので、数えたあとに金額と手数料をご説明します。説明後に入金するかお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: It depends on the count. Afterwards we will explain the amount and fees. You may choose whether to deposit after hearing that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、まず数えてください。金額を聞いてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 集計後に入金を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then count them first. I will decide after hearing the amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to decide on depositing after counting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。集計が済みましたらお呼びしますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will call when counting is finished. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍ぎょうざをお探しですか。こちらに二つの大きさがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Looking for frozen gyoza? We have two pack sizes here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人で食べるので、一度に全部使わなくてもいい物を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一度に全部使わない商品を探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I eat alone, so I am looking for something I do not have to use all at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a product you can use in portions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小袋は十二個、大袋は三十個入りです。大袋はこちらに開封後の保存方法が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The small bag has twelve, the large bag thirty. Storage after opening the large bag is explained here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この「口を閉じて冷凍」という所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開封後の保存表示の位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This part saying “close the bag and freeze,” right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm where the after-opening storage label is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。使う分だけ取り出して、袋の口を閉じて冷凍庫へ戻すように書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. It says to take out only what you need, close the bag, and put it back in the freezer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋を閉じる留め具は付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋を閉じる留め具の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is a fastener for closing the bag included?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether a bag fastener is included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 付いていません。お持ちでなければ、袋用のクリップが日用品の棚にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: No. If you do not have one, bag clips are on the household-goods shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家にクリップがあるので大丈夫です。大袋の値段を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手持ちの留め具を伝え大袋の価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have clips at home, so that is fine. How much is the large bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have a fastener and ask the large bag's price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 五百八十円です。小袋は二百六十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: 580 yen. The small bag is260 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大袋を一つにします。家で少しずつ使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大袋を選び少しずつ使う予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take one large bag. I will use it gradually at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a large bag and say you will use it in small portions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。レジは通路の奥です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are. The checkout is at the far end of the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇の絵を描かれるのでしょうか。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you draw the flowerbeds? Can I help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この折り畳み椅子に座って描いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の椅子を使って写生する許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. May I sit on this folding chair to draw?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to sketch using your own chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 個人の写生でしたら大丈夫です。通路をふさがない場所でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Individual sketching is fine. Please choose somewhere that does not block the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花がよく見えるので、この角に置きたいのですが、通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 置きたい場所が通行を妨げないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the flowers well here, so I want this corner. Can people still pass?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether your chosen position obstructs passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そこは人が曲がる所なので、椅子が出てしまいます。少し後ろの広い所はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: People turn there, so the chair would stick out. How about the wider area a little behind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後ろへ下がります。ここなら、かばんも横に置けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所を変更し荷物を置く位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move back. May I put my bag beside me here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Change position and ask where to put luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、椅子のそばへまとめてください。花壇の中には入らず、こちら側からお描きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, keep it together beside the chair. Do not enter the flowerbed; draw from this side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。水彩絵の具を使いますが、汚れた水はどうすればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件を了承し絵の具の水の処理を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I use watercolors. What should I do with the dirty water?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the conditions and ask how to dispose of paint water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 公園では捨てられません。ふたの閉まる容器に入れて、お持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You cannot discard it in the park. Put it in a container with a closing lid and take it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水はこの容器に戻して持ち帰ります。場所を見てくださって、ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水を持ち帰る方法を伝え礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the water back in this container and take it home. Thank you for checking the spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain taking the water home and give thanks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、ゆっくり描いてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time drawing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのケースは、持ち上げて運べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you lift and carry that case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中にチェロが入っていますので、なるべく立てたまま運びたいんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: チェロのケースを立てて運びたい事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a cello inside. I want to keep it upright as much as possible while carrying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to carry the cello case upright. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 階段を避ける必要がありますね。乗り換える列車はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to avoid stairs, then. Have you decided your connecting train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この時刻の列車に乗りますが、乗り換えの時間が短くて心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗換時間が短いことへの不安を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This departure, but I am worried the transfer time is short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain concern about the short transfer time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図では、エレベーターを使う経路は少し遠回りになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to the map, the elevator route is a slight detour.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 近道より、ケースを傾けずに運べる経路を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケースを傾けずに通れる経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than a shortcut, could you show a route where I can carry it without tilting the case?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a route that does not require tilting the case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらを回ります。途中に狭い通路があるので、そこで急いで追い越さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go around here. There is a narrow passage on the way; do not hurry to overtake people there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 狭い所はゆっくり進みますが、乗り遅れたらどこで次の列車を調べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗換に遅れた場合の列車情報の確認先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move slowly through narrow places. If I miss the train, where can I check the next one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to check train information if you miss the connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗換先の案内表示で確認できます。迷ったらケースを安全な場所に置いて、係員にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the displays where you transfer. If unsure, put the case somewhere safe and ask staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 無理に急がず、案内表示で次の列車を確認することにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 急がず次の列車を確認する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not rush beyond what is safe. I will check the display for the next train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid rushing and check the next train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのほうが安心ですね。楽器を大切に、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is safer. Take care of your instrument and have a good journey.
